entities.summary: Robert Paul Rasmussen is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Toronto Blue Jays and the Seattle Mariners. Prior to his professional career, Rasmussen attended the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and played college baseball for the UCLA Bruins.
